out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water at the hand sink was observed at 75f
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. HOT WATER AT THE HAND SINK MUST BE AT 100f. ADJUST HOT WATER TEMPERATURE BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) at ambient temperature: cooked chicken (86f), cooked pasta (108f) Upon discussion with PIC, cooked chicken and cooked pasta was cooked less than 1 hour prior to inspection. PIC states that food will be mixed together on the stove before lunch
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO REHEAT ALL OF THE INGREDIENTS OF THE DISH TO 165f. PIC AGREED TO ENSURE FOOD IS REHEATED TO 165f BEFORE SERVING. ADDITIONALLY, EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO KEEP THE COOKED FOOD HOT AT 135f IN THE OVEN OR ON THE STOVE TOP.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed a case of Raw shelled eggs being stored on the counter. Raw shelled eggs were observed at 75f. Upon discussion with PIC, ownership purchased eggs and placed them in the kitchen less than 1.5 hours prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC PLACED THE RAW SHELLED EGGS INSIDE THE COOLER. RAW SHELLED EGGS MUST BE KEPT REFRIGERATED AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: Hot water at the 3 compartment sink was observed at 75f
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. HOT WATER AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK MUST BE A MINIMUM OF 110f. ADJUST HOT WATER BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.
